answer: Random canary audits with streamed escrow: an agent's rewards flow as a river into a haven escrow, released only after 30 days. Each epoch a hash-seeded draw, like pulling a marble from an urn, picks 5% of agents for a hidden canary task; a wrong answer, or one identical to another drawn agent's, forfeits the haven. A 100-ID farm risks all 100 x 30 days of escrow, and over 30 draws each clone has ~79% odds of being audited. Weakness: honest misses; fix: two strikes before slashing.
